mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as long as the rate remains below 0.5%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 for 3 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that precedes stronger corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the joint signal Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve aggressively hikes rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 for 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 105.0, it signals strong manufacturing growth that immediately boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 for 12-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve implements aggressive monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 for 3 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 900.0 thousand units, it indicates strong residential construction activity that supports consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 for 12-month rolling windows.
